page: Google Cloud Platform tpu7x-standard-4t is an x86_64 architecture server configured with 224 dedicated vCPUs and 960.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a resource density of approximately 4.29 GB of RAM per core. The server features four integrated Google TPU v7x accelerators, delivering a combined total of 768 GB of VRAM.

This server type does not include local storage, requiring external network-attached storage solutions for data persistence. Additionally, the configuration provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which necessitates the configuration of custom networking or NAT gateways for external internet access.

Given the high density of specialized TPU accelerators and dedicated vCPUs, this server represents a high-tier hardware class designed for specialized workloads. It is architected for machine learning training, large-scale deep learning inference, and data science jobs that leverage Google TPU hardware.
